description_en: Queries the pool information associated with a plan credential
description_zh: 查询套餐凭证对应的池信息
name: GetCredentialPoolStatistics

parameters.help_en: The month for which to query the plan data usage details
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的套餐流量使用详情的月份
parameters.name: date

parameters.help_en:
The plan credential. You can obtain the plan credential by using one of the following methods:

- On the **Plan Credential** page of the [IoT SIM Service console](https://dyiotnext.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.6a072d25p4pUg8), view the plan credential.

- Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/374328.html operation and view the plan credential (CredentialNo) in the response parameters
parameters.help_zh:
套餐凭证。获取方法如下：

- 在[物联网SIM服务控制台](https://dyiotnext.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.6a072d25p4pUg8)的**套餐凭证**页面，查看套餐凭证。

- 调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/374328.html，在返回参数中查看套餐凭证（CredentialNo）
parameters.name: credential_no
